answer: One concrete mechanism: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its glacier recurs, its opal survives audit, and a terrace from an unlinked peer confirms it.
